SELECT T6.TARGET_NAME assetType10Str, T1.ENTRUST_ID entrustId, T1.ENTRUST_STATUS entrustStatus, T1.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, T2.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, T3.ASSET_TYPE1 assetType1, T3.ASSET_TYPE_10 assetType10, T3.ASSET_TYPE_11 assetType11, T3.BUSI_PS ps, T3.TERM_DAYS termDays, T3.EXERCISE_TYPE exerciseType, T1.VDATE vdate, T1.MDATE mdate, T1.INV_MANAGER_ID invManagerId, T1.ENTRUST_NUM entrustNum, T1.REMARK remark FROM ETR_ENTRUST T1 inner join PTL_PORTFOLIO T2 on T2.PORTFOLIO_ID = T1.PORTFOLIO_ID inner join ETR_ENTRUST_ADD T3 on T3.ENTRUST_ID = T1.ENTRUST_ID inner join PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY T5 on T2.PORTFOLIO_ID=T5.PORTFOLIO_ID and T5.USER_ID= #{loginUser} inner join OPT_TARGET_INFO T6 on T3.ASSET_TYPE_10 = T6.TARGET_ID
AND ((T2.PORTFOLIO_ID IN
null) OR T2.PORTFOLIO_ID IN in (
#{prot} ) or (T2.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID IN
null) OR T2.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID in (
#{prot} ) )
AND T3.ASSET_TYPE_11 in
#{item}
AND T3.ASSET_TYPE_10 in
#{item}
AND T3.BUSI_PS =#{ps}
AND T3.EXERCISE_TYPE =#{exerciseType}
AND T1.ENTRUST_STATUS in
#{item}
AND T1.VDATE >= to_date(#{startDate},'yyyy-mm-dd')
AND T1.MDATE <=to_date(#{endDate},'yyyy-mm-dd')
AND T3.ASSET_TYPE in(#{option})
ORDER BY T1.ENTRUST_ID DESC

SELECT T1.TARGET_ID code, T1.TARGET_NAME name, T1.TARGET_TYPE shortName, T1.TARGET_ID hidCode FROM OPT_TARGET_INFO T1
(T1.PORTFOLIO_ID like concat('%',concat(#{param},'%')) or T1.PORTFOLIO_NAME like concat('%',concat(#{param},'%')))

SELECT T1.TARGET_ID id, T1.TARGET_NAME text FROM OPT_TARGET_INFO T1
and T1.TARGET_ID = #{initValue}
and (T1.TARGET_ID like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')) or T1.TARGET_NAME like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')))
AND T1.PORTFOLIO_TYPE IN (#{portType}, #{portType1})

select T4.TARGET_NAME assetType10Str, T1.ENTRUST_ID entrustId, T1.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, T1.VDATE vdate, T1.MDATE mdate, T1.CCY ccy, T2.ASSET_TYPE1 assetType1, T2.ASSET_TYPE_10 assetType10, T2.ASSET_TYPE_11 assetType11, T2.EXERCISE_TYPE exerciseType, T2.EXEC_BASE_DATE execBaseDate, T2.OPT_FEE_PAY_TYPE optFeePayType, T2.OPT_FEE_PAY_TYPE2 optFeePayType2, T2.EXE_PRICE exePrice, T2.KNOCK_PRICE knockPrice, T2.LOW_HIND_PRICE lowHindPrice, T2.LOW_EXERC_PRICE lowExercPrice, T2.HIGH_HIND_PRICE highHindPrice, T2.HIGH_EXERC_PRICE highExercPrice, T2.BUSI_PS ps, T1.TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket, T1.ENTRUST_NUM entrustNum, T2.VDATE vdateAdd, T2.MDATE mdateAdd, T2.TERM_DAYS termDays, T1.CALENDAR_ID calendarId, T1.INV_MANAGER_ID invManagerId, T3.TRADER trader, T1.COUNTER_ID counterId, T1.COUNTER_TRADER counterTrader, T1.CONTACT_INFO contactInfo, T1.REMARK remark from ETR_ENTRUST T1 LEFT JOIN ETR_ENTRUST_ADD T2 ON T1.ENTRUST_ID = T2.ENTRUST_ID LEFT JOIN ETR_DISTRIBUTE T3 ON T1.ENTRUST_ID = T3.ENTRUST_ID LEFT JOIN OPT_TARGET_INFO T4 ON T2.ASSET_TYPE_10 = T4.TARGET_ID
T1.ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId}
